reaction_composition: PCR, per 25 uL reaction: 12.5 uL 2X high-fidelity master mix, 1.25 uL each primer at 10 uM (500 nM final, matching the primer_conc_nm the Tm values were computed at), 1 to 10 ng template, water to 25 uL.
Confirm the master mix lot insert before use: the conditions below are the vendor's published defaults, not a measurement from this build.
Assembly, per 20 uL reaction: 10 uL NEBuilder HiFi 2X master mix, 0.03 to 0.2 pmol of each purified fragment, water to 20 uL. Use equimolar fragments and keep the total insert DNA under 1 pmol.
protocol.annealing_rule: Lowest primer binding-region Tm in the set is 59.7 C (nearest-neighbor, SantaLucia 1998 unified parameters, at 500 nM primer and 50 mM monovalent salt). Annealing temperature is that minus the configured 5.0 C offset, giving 54.7 C. A high-fidelity polymerase often tolerates a higher annealing temperature than this conservative rule gives; raise it if the vendor's own calculator says so.

pcr_program.label: Anneal, derived from the computed Tm
Extend, 30 s per kb for a 200 bp longest amplicon

protocol.expected_outcome: Each PCR gives one band: frag_a_amplicon at 200 bp, frag_b_amplicon at 200 bp. The assembled construct is approximately 360 bp, being the 2 fragments joined in the order frag_a to frag_b. Transform the assembly reaction directly and screen colonies by PCR across each junction, then sequence the junctions.
sources: PCR cycling: NEB Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase standard protocol.
Annealing temperature: derived from the nearest-neighbor Tm of the primer binding regions (SantaLucia 1998 unified parameters, Appendix A), not assumed.
Assembly incubation: NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly protocol, 50 C for 15 minutes for two or three fragments and 60 minutes for four to six.
Method: Gibson et al. 2009, Nat Methods 6:343-345.

junction_map.label: 20 bp homology arm
junction_map.detail: The frag_a forward primer carries the last 20 bp of frag_b as a 5' tail (TTTTGACCTCCATAGAAGAC), so the two amplicons share that sequence and anneal after exonuclease chew-back. Overlap Tm 56.1 C.

junction_map.label: 20 bp homology arm

checks.label: Primer melting temperature in range
checks.message: Every primer melts within 3.0 C of the 60.0 C target (frag_a_F 59.7 C; frag_a_R 60.8 C; frag_b_F 60.6 C; frag_b_R 60.4 C). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F 59.7 C; frag_a_R 60.8 C; frag_b_F 60.6 C; frag_b_R 60.4 C
checks.threshold: target 60.0 C, warn outside 57.0 to 63.0 C, fail beyond 10.0 C
checks.citation: Nearest-neighbor thermodynamics, SantaLucia 1998 unified parameters (Appendix A). Window from the Primer3 defaults PRIMER_MIN_TM 57 / PRIMER_OPT_TM 60 / PRIMER_MAX_TM 63.

checks.label: Primer pair melting temperature difference
checks.message: Every pair is within 5.0 C (frag_a_F/frag_a_R 1.1 C; frag_b_F/frag_b_R 0.2 C), so one annealing temperature serves the whole set. No change needed.
checks.threshold: at most 5.0 C within a pair
checks.citation: Standard primer design guidance (NEB Tm Calculator usage notes, IDT primer design guidelines) keeps a pair within about 5 C so one annealing temperature serves both. Primer3's PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_DIFF_TM exposes the same control but defaults to 100 C, unconstrained.

checks.label: Primer GC content
checks.message: Every primer's binding region is within 40% to 60% GC (frag_a_F 47%; frag_a_R 45%; frag_b_F 47%; frag_b_R 43%). No change needed.
checks.citation: 40 to 60 percent is the standard primer GC recommendation (NEB and IDT primer design documentation). Primer3's PRIMER_MIN_GC / PRIMER_MAX_GC default to the wider 20 to 80 percent synthesis window.

checks.label: Primer length
checks.message: Every primer is within binding 18 to 27 nt, total at most 60 nt (frag_a_F 19 nt binding, 39 nt total; frag_a_R 22 nt binding, 22 nt total; frag_b_F 19 nt binding, 39 nt total; frag_b_R 23 nt binding, 23 nt total). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F 19 nt binding, 39 nt total; frag_a_R 22 nt binding, 22 nt total; frag_b_F 19 nt binding, 39 nt total; frag_b_R 23 nt binding, 23 nt total
checks.threshold: binding 18 to 27 nt, total at most 60 nt

checks.label: Primer 3' end composition
checks.message: Every 3' end satisfies at most 3 G or C in the last 5 bases, 3' base not T (frag_a_F 3'-GCGAA, 3 GC, ends A; frag_a_R 3'-ACAGC, 3 GC, ends C; frag_b_F 3'-CACCA, 3 GC, ends A; frag_b_R 3'-AACAG, 2 GC, ends G). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F 3'-GCGAA, 3 GC, ends A; frag_a_R 3'-ACAGC, 3 GC, ends C; frag_b_F 3'-CACCA, 3 GC, ends A; frag_b_R 3'-AACAG, 2 GC, ends G
checks.threshold: at most 3 G or C in the last 5 bases, 3' base not T
checks.citation: Rule stated in section 7.5 check 5. Five-base window follows Primer3's PRIMER_MAX_END_STABILITY, which is measured over the last five 3' bases.

checks.label: Primer hairpin
checks.message: No primer folds past the threshold (frag_a_F 0.0 kcal/mol; frag_a_R -0.5 kcal/mol; frag_b_F -1.4 kcal/mol; frag_b_R 0.0 kcal/mol). Measured as minimum free energy in kcal/mol, ViennaRNA 2.7.2 with DNA parameters (dna_mathews2004). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F 0.0 kcal/mol; frag_a_R -0.5 kcal/mol; frag_b_F -1.4 kcal/mol; frag_b_R 0.0 kcal/mol
checks.threshold: warn at -2.0 kcal/mol, fail at -3.0 kcal/mol with the 3' end in the stem
checks.citation: Section 7.4. Free energy threshold is a configurable default in the units IDT OligoAnalyzer reports; Primer3 expresses the same constraint as PRIMER_MAX_HAIRPIN_TH, a hairpin Tm of 47 C. Minimum loop size 3 nt is the standard nucleic acid secondary structure minimum, as in ViennaRNA.

checks.label: Primer self-dimer
checks.message: No primer self-dimerises past at most 8 bp internally and 3 bp at the 3' end (frag_a_F any 6 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_a_R any 6 bp, 3' 3 bp; frag_b_F any 6 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_b_R any 4 bp, 3' 2 bp). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F any 6 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_a_R any 6 bp, 3' 3 bp; frag_b_F any 6 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_b_R any 4 bp, 3' 2 bp
checks.threshold: at most 8 bp internally and 3 bp at the 3' end
checks.citation: Primer3 defaults PRIMER_MAX_SELF_ANY 8.00 and PRIMER_MAX_SELF_END 3.00, in base pairs.

checks.label: Primer pair hetero-dimer
checks.message: No pair dimerises past at most 8 bp internally and 3 bp at either 3' end (frag_a_F/frag_a_R any 5 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_b_F/frag_b_R any 7 bp, 3' 3 bp). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_a_F/frag_a_R any 5 bp, 3' 2 bp; frag_b_F/frag_b_R any 7 bp, 3' 3 bp
checks.threshold: at most 8 bp internally and 3 bp at either 3' end
checks.citation: Primer3 defaults PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_COMPL_ANY 8.00 and PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_COMPL_END 3.00, in base pairs.

checks.label: Primer specificity in the template set
checks.message: Every primer binds exactly once across the 2 supplied templates (frag_a_F 1; frag_a_R 1; frag_b_F 1; frag_b_R 1). No change needed.
checks.threshold: exactly one occurrence per primer across the supplied template set
checks.citation: Section 7.5 check 9: the binding region must occur exactly once in the supplied template set. Both strands are searched.

checks.label: Primer homopolymer run
checks.message: No primer carries a run over 5 nucleotides (longest run per primer: frag_a_F 0; frag_a_R 0; frag_b_F 0; frag_b_R 0). No change needed.
checks.observed: longest run per primer: frag_a_F 0; frag_a_R 0; frag_b_F 0; frag_b_R 0
checks.citation: Primer3 default PRIMER_MAX_POLY_X 5. A longer run slips during oligo synthesis and during polymerase extension.

checks.label: Gibson terminal homology length
checks.message: All 2 junctions share 15 to 40 bp terminal homology (frag_b to frag_a 20 bp; frag_a to frag_b 20 bp). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_b to frag_a 20 bp; frag_a to frag_b 20 bp
checks.citation: Gibson et al. 2009, Nat Methods 6:343-345 used 40 bp overlaps; the NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly protocol recommends 15 to 20 bp for a few fragments. The window spans both.

checks.label: Gibson overlap melting temperature
checks.message: Every overlap melts at or above 48.0 C (frag_b to frag_a 56.1 C; frag_a to frag_b 56.6 C). No change needed.
checks.observed: frag_b to frag_a 56.1 C; frag_a to frag_b 56.6 C
checks.citation: The NEBuilder Assembly Tool designs overlaps to a melting temperature of at least 48 C.

checks.label: Gibson junction homology uniqueness
checks.message: No two junctions share 10 bp or more (longest homology shared between two junctions: 4 bp), so only the intended order can assemble. No change needed.
checks.observed: longest homology shared between two junctions: 4 bp
checks.threshold: under 10 bp shared between any two junctions
checks.citation: Section 7.5 check 13. The shared-homology limit is a configurable default: mis-assembly needs enough cross-complementarity between two junctions to survive the 50 C NEBuilder HiFi incubation.

checks.label: Assembly order unambiguous
checks.message: Each of the 2 junctions has its own joining sequence, so the fragments can assemble in exactly one order: frag_a to frag_b. No change needed.
checks.threshold: one distinct joining sequence per junction
checks.citation: Section 7.5 check 18. A one-pot assembly is only usable if the overhang topology admits exactly one order.

checks.label: Expected amplicon size
checks.message: Every expected amplicon is within 100 to 10000 bp per amplicon (frag_a_amplicon 200 bp; frag_b_amplicon 200 bp). No change needed.
checks.citation: NEB Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase protocol: 20 to 30 seconds per kilobase extension, documented to about 10 kb. The lower bound keeps the amplicon resolvable from primer dimer.

parameters_used.divalent_conversion: von Ahsen et al. 2001, Clin Chem 47:1956-1961: [Na_eq] = [Na+] + 120 * sqrt([Mg2+] - [dNTP])
parameters_used.tm_model: nearest-neighbor thermodynamics, SantaLucia 1998 unified parameters (Appendix A), with the Appendix A monovalent entropy salt correction
parameters_used.tm_measured_on: primer template-binding region, excluding any 5' tail
parameters_used.dimer_score_definition: gapless sliding-window complementarity in base pairs; 'any' is the best gapless local score at any offset, '3 prime' is the longest contiguous complementary run anchored at a 3' terminal base. Thresholds are the Primer3 defaults in the same units.
parameters_used.host_codon_usage: none bundled with this build; host codon frequencies are reported as UNKNOWN
parameters_used.overhang_standard: none supplied; Golden Gate overhangs are taken from the fragment junctions
parameters_used.checks_not_evaluated_reason: A check applicable to the strategy but with nothing to examine in this design, for example a junction check on a single-fragment assembly. Omitted rather than reported as a pass.
